name: Semaphore-UI
description: Web UI to run Ansible, Terraform, OpenTofu and scripts

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Everything Semaphore keeps: its config (config), the SQLite database (db), cloned repositories (tmp) and this install's own keys (secrets.env, .admin_password). Back it up.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Semaphore UI web UI and API, published on host as 6778

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: SEMAPHORE_ADMIN
variables.description: The admin's user name. Only used on the first start.

variables.name: SEMAPHORE_ADMIN_EMAIL
variables.description: The admin's email. Only used on the first start.

variables.name: SEMAPHORE_ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.description: The admin's password. Leave it empty and one is made for you: it is shown in the app's logs, in the box marked CREDENTIALS. Only used on the first start.
